name: Terra Alta
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Catalan appellation. Rules allow Garnacha Blanca, Garnacha Tinta, Macabeo and Syrah among others. Garnacha Blanca, Garnacha Tinta and Garnacha Peluda are its dominant and oldest grapes.
